free_tier_limits.correction: Default limit: 1,000 requests per hour per API key, although service-specific limits may vary. DEMO_KEY is limited to 30 requests per IP per hour and 50 per IP per day.

rate_limits.correction: Published: the default is 1,000 requests per hour per API key, with possible service-specific limits.

description.correction: The NLR Developer Network provides API-key-authenticated access to National Laboratory of the Rockies energy data services, including NSRDB, PVWatts, AFDC station data, utility-rate services, and wind-resource tools. The former NREL name and developer.nrel.gov domain are obsolete.

notes: The HTTP 0 results reflect a real shutdown: developer.nrel.gov was retired May 29, 2026, after NREL became NLR. Current documentation and API calls use developer.nlr.gov. The official site publishes limits, contradicting both unknown/not-published claims. Utility Rates v3 remains available but serves 2012 data with no planned updates.
